meta.name: schema
meta.description: When the user wants to add, fix, or optimize schema markup and structured data on their site. Also use when the user mentions "schema markup," "structured data," "JSON-LD," "rich snippets," "schema.org," "FAQ schema," "product schema," "review schema," "breadcrumb schema," "Google rich results," "knowledge panel," "star ratings in search," or "add structured data." Use this whenever someone wants their pages to show enhanced results in Google. For broader SEO issues, see seo-audit. For AI search optimization, see ai-seo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页加上结构化数据，让搜索结果展示星级、问答等丰富信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经营网站，想让 Google 搜索结果更显眼。
copy.tagline_en: Add structured data to your pages for richer Google results.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a website and want richer results on Google.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以结构化数据专家的方式工作:先了解页面类型、现有 schema 与目标,再依据 schema.org 和 Google 指南生成 JSON-LD 标记,并用 Rich Results Test 等工具给出校验清单。
howto.when: 当用户想添加、修复或优化网站的 schema 标记/结构化数据,提到「schema markup」「JSON-LD」「rich snippets」等关键词,或希望页面在 Google 显示增强结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我给产品页加上 Product 的 JSON-LD
say.note: 会输出完整 JSON-LD 代码块。

say.text: 我网站的 FAQ schema 报错了,帮我修一下
say.note: 会检查必需属性和页面内容。

say.text: 用 Google Rich Results Test 验证这段结构化数据
say.note: 会给出校验清单和错误提示。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a structured data expert: it clarifies page type, current schema, and goals, then writes JSON-LD per schema.org and Google guidelines, and provides a validation checklist (e.g., Rich Results Test).
howto.when_en: Triggered when users want to add, fix, or optimize schema markup/structured data, mention keywords like "schema markup," "JSON-LD," or "rich snippets," or want enhanced Google search results.

say_en.text: Add Product JSON-LD to my product page.
say_en.note: Outputs a full JSON-LD code block.

say_en.text: My FAQ schema is broken—please fix it.
say_en.note: Checks required properties and page content.

say_en.text: Validate this structured data in Google Rich Results Test.
say_en.note: Gives a checklist and error hints.
